tests: Borderless table with two-level headers, merged cells in both directions, genuinely blank cells, and a wrapping free-text column that makes rows unequal in height.
adversarialFeatures: no ruling lines at all — cell boundaries are whitespace only
two-level column headers with depot names spanning paired sub-columns
rowspan on the first and last columns
blank cells that mean 'not operated', not zero
a wrapping notes column producing rows of very unequal height
title: Fleet Utilisation Detail

tables.headerRelationships: Each numeric cell is governed by a depot group header (Northern/Southern), a measure sub-header (Units/Util. %), and a row header (vehicle class).

mergedCells.cell: Notes carried forward from the previous review cycle

tables.blankCellMeaning: Class not operated at that depot. Semantically distinct from zero; a remediation that fills these with 0 is wrong.

intentionalProblems: borderless layout means the table may not be detected as a table at all
blank cells may be dropped rather than preserved as empty
the unequal row heights caused by the notes column may break row association
